name: app-release-notifier
description: Post Expo release events from EAS, App Store Connect and Google Play to Slack, Discord and Teams

scripts.check: tsc && npm run gen:defaults -- --check && npm run docs:check
scripts.docs:check: typedoc --out build/docs && (git diff --no-index --exit-code build/docs docs || (echo 'docs is stale: run npm run docs' && exit 1))
